picks.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers API credentials
picks.summary: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. [...]

picks.title: South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
picks.summary: A threat actor breached the internal network of Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) and accessed two systems containing customer, employee, and contractor data. [...]

picks.title: Chainflip Suspects Key Theft in $12.6 Million Vault Hack
picks.summary: The first report identifies validly signed transfers outside the protocol but leaves parts of the suspected key theft unconfirmed. Services remain paused.

picks.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
picks.summary: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these.

picks.title: DOJ seeks $1.17 billion in USDC tied to Binance hack; Circle could issue replacement tokens
picks.summary: The U.S. Justice Department is seeking to recover about $1.17 billion in USDC tied to the Oct. 29 Binance hack.

picks.title: Spanish LaLiga confirms hackers stole soccer fans’ personal data
picks.summary: LaLiga, Spain s top men s football league, disclosed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to users of its services and those of some affiliated clubs. [...]

picks.title: Behind the Alias: How One Researcher Unmasked a Decade of Ransomware Actors
picks.summary: Ransomware isn t slowing down. A new framework gives security teams the edge to trace attackers back to their source.

picks.title: Cross River Bank launches first bitcoin-backed loans with LendingUSA, offering up to $250,000
picks.summary: LendingUSA and Cross River launch bitcoin-secured loans of $10,000 to $250,000 with 30%, 50% or 70% LTV, so borrowers can keep their BTC.

picks.title: California court terminates lawsuit against Coinbase over TerraUSD purchases
picks.summary: Plaintiff Larry Pearl purchased TerraUSD on Coinbase shortly before the token collapsed and accused Coinbase of misrepresentation.

picks.title: MacBook Neo falls to all-time low $599 in Amazon Black Friday sale — 256GB Citrus model price matches its original launch (Update: now $649)
picks.summary: Apple s MacBook Neo in citrus is down to $599, its original launch price from earlier this year, at Amazon.
